scripts.build:macos: tauri build --target aarch64-apple-darwin -- --locked && node scripts/collect-packages.mjs aarch64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:macos:intel: tauri build --target x86_64-apple-darwin -- --locked && node scripts/collect-packages.mjs x86_64-apple-darwin
scripts.build:windows: tauri build --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc --bundles nsis --config src-tauri/tauri.windows.conf.json -- --locked && node scripts/collect-packages.mjs x86_64-pc-windows-msvc
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests/ui "scripts/**/*.mjs" *.json *.ts index.html src-tauri/*.json src-tauri/capabilities/*.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests/ui "scripts/**/*.mjs" *.json *.ts index.html src-tauri/*.json src-tauri/capabilities/*.json
